lucky.name: Golden Butterfly
lucky.text: A golden butterfly! It left a little shimmer of coins behind.

lucky.name: Blue Morpho
lucky.text: A rare blue butterfly! Here's a ribbon for spotting it.

lucky.name: Lucky Ladybug
lucky.text: A lucky ladybug! Good fortune (and a few coins).

lucky.name: Seven Spot
lucky.text: Seven spots, seven lucky splinters. Here's some lumber.

lucky.name: Traveling Tourist
lucky.text: A tourist from Seattle wants to buy something rustic. They will pay double!

season.name: Pumpkin Days
season.text: Everything orange sells for a little more at Claire's and the market.

season.name: Candy Cane Lane
season.text: Festive goods are in high demand this week.

season.name: Spring Egg Hunt
season.text: Eggs and pastel treats sell for more. Lucky critters show up more often.

season.name: Beach Bash
season.text: Summer visitors crave sweet treats, and you earn extra XP.

season.name: Spooky Week
season.text: Pumpkins and caramel apples are flying off the shelves.

season.name: Holiday Lights
season.text: Twinkly lights on every fence. Ribbons for everyone.
